name: prompt-rail
description: A rail of your session's prompts beside the transcript, above or below the prompt; hover to read one, click to jump to it.

mode.title: Rail mode
mode.description: off: no rail. vertical: a pane beside the transcript, one row per prompt. horizontal: a row of bars above the prompt input (terminal only). below: a row of bars under the hint line below the prompt input (terminal only; the desktop app keeps it above). /prompt-rail off|vertical|horizontal|below changes it too and shows where the rail sits.

classicHooks.title: Classic hooks
classicHooks.description: Register the classic.SessionStart and classic.Stop hooks, which name the transcript exactly. Off silences Claude Code's notes about the security default skipping them on a machine with managed settings or in a Team or Enterprise organization, where they never ran anyway; elsewhere, off leaves a session resumed from another directory, or an install loaded with --plugin-dir, with no transcript to read.
